scenes.eyebrow: The day, for a unit manager
scenes.headline: You answer for your unit
scenes.line: Unit managers. You have your own day, and then you have your unit. On Wednesday you answer for them, person by person.
scenes.tail: The chair does not read your unit out. You do

scenes.headline: Your blocks, before your unit's
scenes.line: Your own blocks come first, and they are read the same way as everybody else's. Two in, one late, one ahead. Nobody is exempt because they manage.

blocks.did: Called four of the unit, two field appointments set

scenes.headline: A median that hides a queue
scenes.line: Thirteen fact finds are waiting on you. Your median is one point four days, which reads well. The oldest in the branch has waited thirty seven. A median that good with a tail that long is a median hiding a queue.
scenes.note: An advisor cannot sell a case that is sitting in a review queue. That is why the count routes it, never the median.

scenes.headline: Each one has their own question
scenes.line: And each of your people walks in with their own question, chosen by their own numbers. Nobody is skipped, including the one who is doing well.

words3: Know what each of yours filed.
scenes.line: Clear your review queue. Know what each of yours filed. Bring their answers, not yours. That is what the unit round is.
